items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: My father was Jesse L. Thompson, and my mother was Laura Walker Thompson.

ctx.x: tion district 8073, registration number 345. That should be enough information from that to identify this paper from the vital statistics bureau.

And my birth place was Springfield, Ohio, and my place of residence, the residence of my parents was 361 Henzo Avenue, and my full name is Charles Philip Walker Thompson, which I believe most of those names were named after people in my family who were either ministers or physicians perhaps. At least I know that one of them was a minister in the family beside my father, I believe it was on the Walker side, which is my mother. And my birth date was March the 21st, 1918. My father was Jesse L. Thompson, and my…

And on the birth certificate which is very significant at this time of this interview, May the 5th,1975, my father is listed, his race as colored, c-o-l-o-r-e-d, something I would like to discuss in this interview. And his age was 41, my mother was also listed as colored, aged 38. My father's birth place and my mother's birth place was Mount Sterling, Kentucky.
